desc_en: This racerback tank top combines a bold design with an essential athletic silhouette. Its sporty cut is engineered to provide complete freedom of movement during every workout. The piece features a distinct front graphic that brings character and attitude to your performance wear. Each item is made to order and features worldwide shipping to ensure maximum exclusivity and quality with every delivery.
